title: Platform Core Baseline V31 Identity Record

authoritative_identity.source_commit_subject: G31 R21E: neutralize historical worker selection identity
authoritative_identity.immediate_successor_subject: docs(governance): certify G32-07 filesystem adapter executable constitutional contract v1
authoritative_identity.historical_cutoff_rule: PCBV31 is exactly the repository state identified by source_commit and source_tree. The immediate successor begins post-V31 work and is not part of PCBV31.

constitutional_terminology.definition: In V31-era evidence, Platform Core names the single accepted platform baseline and is identified as PCBV31. In current architecture, Platform Core names the evolving governed platform containing PCBV31 plus separately certified post-V31 capabilities. The current scope is therefore broader than the historical PCBV31 baseline without contradicting the V31-era coextensive identity.

The closed V31 certified reference realization identified exclusively by the exact authenticated source_commit and source_tree in this record. PCBV31 does not expand when later Platform Core components or later versions of identically named files are added.

The V31-owned deterministic sequencing and binding chain that accepts a constitutionally prepared request at the certified entry socket, preserves authority and evidence continuity across governed execution stages, and reaches the independent Certification handoff. It does not absorb the independent protocol owners it binds.

A bounded capability governed within Platform Core. A capability realization is part of the historical PCBV31 membership only when committed evidence assigns its exact V31 implementation to Platform Core and this record classifies it as PCBV31_EXECUTION_SPINE or PCBV31_BASELINE_SUPPORT.
A Platform Core capability introduced after the authenticated PCBV31 source_commit. It remains outside PCBV31 unless a new constitutional baseline expressly supersedes V31.

A record-local inventory label for an exact V31 Platform Core-owned implementation that supports the certified baseline but is not part of the G31 execution-spine subset. This label organizes authenticated evidence and does not claim to be pre-existing canonical constitutional vocabulary.

terminology_reconciliation.historical_meaning: At V31 there was one accepted Platform Core baseline, identified as PCBV31.
terminology_reconciliation.current_meaning: Platform Core has subsequently acquired separately certified post-V31 capabilities while PCBV31 remains the closed historical V31 realization.
terminology_reconciliation.non_contradiction_rule: The historical identity is version-scoped. It does not require current Platform Core and historical PCBV31 to remain coextensive.
terminology_reconciliation.canonical_layer_relationship: This record classifies implementation ownership inside the existing canonical layer and authority models. It creates no new layer, authority tier, or protocol family.

constitutional_membership_decision.evaluated_model_a: Every relevant implementation blob present in the authenticated tree is a PCBV31 member.
constitutional_membership_decision.evaluated_model_b: Only evidence-assigned Platform Core realization components are PCBV31 members; other blobs retain independent, external, tooling, or historical dispositions.
reasoning: G31 evidence certifies an explicit lifecycle and its owner-preserving bindings rather than converting every repository blob into the execution spine.
G8 planning evidence delegates Governance, Replay, Worker Platform, and OCS responsibilities to their existing owners.
G15 capability-registry evidence distinguishes Platform Core metadata ownership from runtime, Worker, Provider, Replay, Approval, and Human Interface authority.
G34 adapter topology requires adapter-specific logic and evidence to remain outside PCBV31 despite co-location in the authenticated repository tree.
constitutional_membership_decision.membership_rule: The complete PCBV31 constitutional membership within the declared review set is the union of PCBV31_EXECUTION_SPINE and PCBV31_BASELINE_SUPPORT. All other dispositions identify authenticated V31-tree context but not PCBV31 constitutional membership.

membership_rules: Membership is evaluated against the exact source_tree, not against the current working tree or a mutable branch name.
An included path identifies only the blob and responsibility present at the source_tree; later revisions of the same path do not inherit PCBV31 membership.
A component absent from the source_tree is excluded from PCBV31.
A path classified as PCBV31_BOUND_INDEPENDENT_PROTOCOL_IMPLEMENTATION is present in the V31 tree but remains owned by its independent protocol authority.
The term PCBV31_BASELINE_SUPPORT is a taxonomy introduced by this record and carries only the bounded meaning declared in constitutional_terminology.
A bound independent protocol owner is not absorbed into PCBV31 by invocation, evidence exchange, or lifecycle dependency.
Adapter-specific logic, Workers, Providers, interfaces, and post-V31 capabilities remain external unless this record explicitly identifies a V31-owned boundary binding.
Changing a certified socket, ownership boundary, authority boundary, execution-spine responsibility, or source identity requires a new constitutional baseline rather than mutation of this record.

complete_reviewed_inventory.coverage_statement: The inventory exhaustively classifies every Python implementation path selected by the review contract: all aigol/runtime platform_*.py and platform_core_*.py files; all Approval, Authorization, Replay, Worker lifecycle, Human Interface, adapter, capability, planning, validation, mutation-governance, termination, and certification-binding matches; every exact execution-spine and prior support path; every implementation owner named by the V31 capability certification registry; and all Python files under aigol/workers, aigol/provider, aigol/cli, and aigol/acli_next.
complete_reviewed_inventory.excluded_from_completeness_claim: Unselected historical runtime experiments and domain implementations are not claimed as reviewed merely because they exist elsewhere in the repository tree.
complete_reviewed_inventory.relevance_exclusion_rule: A V31 Python path outside this set is not used to prove or deny PCBV31 membership: it is neither named by the required review families, the certified G31 spine, the prior record, nor the V31 capability registry implementation-owner evidence. It requires a new evidence-based review before any future membership claim.

disposition_semantics.PCBV31_EXECUTION_SPINE: Exact V31 implementation participating in the explicitly certified G31 execution lifecycle.
disposition_semantics.PCBV31_BASELINE_SUPPORT: Exact V31 Platform Core-owned support implementation outside the execution-spine subset; this is record-local taxonomy.
disposition_semantics.PCBV31_BOUND_INDEPENDENT_PROTOCOL_IMPLEM: Implementation present in the V31 tree but constitutionally owned by Approval, Authorization, Replay, Governance, Certification, or another independently preserved protocol owner.
disposition_semantics.EXTERNAL_CONTRACT_BOUND_OWNER: Worker, Provider, or other execution owner bound by contract but not owned by PCBV31.
disposition_semantics.EXTERNAL_ADAPTER_OR_INTERFACE: Interface or adapter implementation outside PCBV31, including adapter-specific evidence bindings.
disposition_semantics.HISTORICAL_SUPPORT_NOT_CONSTITUTIONAL_ME: Historical helper or superseded parallel surface for which the reviewed evidence does not establish PCBV31 constitutional membership.
disposition_semantics.TEST_OR_TOOLING_ONLY: Certification harness, audit helper, inspection command, or tooling surface rather than a PCBV31 runtime member.
disposition_semantics.POST_V31_NOT_PRESENT_IN_BASELINE: Current Platform Core capability path proven absent from the authenticated V31 source tree.
